kind: external-data scaling with matched CE/SupCon controls
checkpoint_rule: Evaluate fixed final host epoch only; no best-epoch selection
promotion: Fixed three-layer readout must reach >=0.4403703704 and fixed 0.15 sparse-pilot blend >=0.4840740741. Compare both CE and SupCon; report selection across two arms. No direct submission from this pilot.
attribution: LoRA and supervised contrastive learning are established methods. Joint CE plus cross-prompt supervised contrastive adaptation here is our experimental combination, not a reproduction of the image-learning paper. Public pool credited to Nishant Dahal and original contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0).
limitations: Scaling increases both examples and optimizer steps; does not isolate those effects
Two-arm candidate selection must be reported
Does not establish gain over complete v16 or v21 ensemble
No new paid compute or model API calls
differences_from_v18: External cap increases from 250 to 1000 per label; more training steps follow the unchanged one-pool-equivalent-epoch rule
Append fixed v19 three-layer readouts; learned-head scores are diagnostics only
